tensorrt: TensorRT 10.15+ (Spark/GB10) or TensorRT 11.x on DGX B200-class x86
notes: DGX Spark (GB10) is ARM and commonly TensorRT 10.15.x on CUDA 13.
DGX B200/GB200 x86 can use TensorRT 11.x with CUDA 13.x.
Use this catalog for Blackwell datacenter/desktop; use 'x86' for Hopper-only boxes.

nvinfer.strongly_typed_note: NetworkDefinitionCreationFlag::kSTRONGLY_TYPED (TensorRT 11: always on; the flag is retained for API compatibility). Tensor DataType is authoritative; TensorRT will not implicitly cast. Listed nvinfer_datatypes must match the ONNX/TRT tensor types.

Attention.restrictions: `Q`, `K`, `V` and `attn_mask ` must be 4D. `past_key`, `past_value` and `nonpad_kv_seqlen` inputs are unsupported. `present_key`, `present_value` and `qk_matmul_output` outputs are unsupported. `qk_matmul_output_mode` and `softcap` attributes are unsupported. `q_num_heads` and `kv_num_heads` attributes are supported via being specified as the second dimension of `Q` and `K`/`V`'s shapes respectively.

AveragePool.restrictions: 2D or 3D Pooling only. `dilations` must be empty or all ones

DFT.restrictions: Runs on a cuFFT-backed plugin so cuFFT must be available at runtime. Complex tensors use the packed-real `[..., 2]` layout, and the innermost dimension must be a static 1 (real) or 2 (complex). The transform axis must be `-2`. The opset 20 `axis` input must be a build-time constant scalar. `dft_length` is required for the onesided inverse (C2R) and unsupported otherwise. FP16 and BF16 require power-of-two signal lengths.

DeformConv.restrictions: `input` must have 1D or 2D spatial dimensions. `pads` for the beginning and end along each spatial axis must be the same

Dropout.restrictions: `is_training` must be an initializer and evaluate to False.

DynamicQuantizeLinear.restrictions: Not supported. TensorRT's IDynamicQuantize can be composed from ONNX operators in the form of a model local function.

GRU.restrictions: For bidirectional GRUs, activation functions must be the same for both the forward and reverse pass

Hardmax.restrictions: `axis` dimension of input must be a build-time constant

If.restrictions: Output tensors of the two conditional branches must have the same rank and must have different names

LayerNormalization.restrictions: Only the first output `Y` is supported.

Loop.restrictions: Scan output length cannot be dynamic. The shape of Loop carried dependencies must be the same across all loop iterations.

LSTM.restrictions: For bidirectional LSTMs, activation functions must be the same for both the forward and reverse pass. `input_forget` attribute must be 0. `layout` attribute must be 0.

LpPool.restrictions: `dilations` must be empty or all ones

MaxPool.restrictions: 2D or 3D pooling only. `Indices` output tensor unsupported. `dilations` must be empty or all ones

Resize.restrictions:
Supported resize transformation modes: `half_pixel`, `pytorch_half_pixel`, `tf_half_pixel_for_nn`, `asymmetric`, and `align_corners`.
Supported resize modes: `nearest`, `linear`.
Supported nearest modes: `floor`, `ceil`, `round_prefer_floor`, `round_prefer_ceil`.
Supported aspect ratio policy: `stretch`.
When `scales` is a tensor input, `axes` must be an iota vector of length rank(input).
Antialiasing is not supported.

RNN.restrictions: For bidirectional RNNs, activation functions must be the same for both the forward and reverse pass

STFT.restrictions: `frame_step` and `window` must be an initializer. Input must be real-valued.

Squeeze.restrictions: `axes` must be resolvable to a constant.

TopK.restrictions: `sorted` must be 1. `K` input must be less than 3840.

Unsqueeze.restrictions: `axes` must be resolvable to a constant.
